description: Two independent ADSR envelope generators, each with a shape control and a polarity switch

params.text: Sets the attack time of the first envelope, 1ms at one end and 10 seconds at the other
Sets the decay time of the first envelope, 1ms at one end and 10 seconds at the other
Sets the level the first envelope holds while its gate stays high
Sets the release time of the first envelope, 1ms at one end and 10 seconds at the other
Sets the attack time of the second envelope, 1ms at one end and 10 seconds at the other
Sets the decay time of the second envelope, 1ms at one end and 10 seconds at the other
Sets the level the second envelope holds while its gate stays high
Sets the release time of the second envelope, 1ms at one end and 10 seconds at the other
Turns the first envelope's output upside down; the setting named Positive is the one that inverts it, and Negative passes the envelope through as it is
Turns the second envelope's output upside down; the setting named Positive is the one that inverts it, and Negative passes the envelope through as it is
Bends the first envelope's segments from a squared curve at one end through a straight line at the middle to a square-root curve at the other
Bends the second envelope's segments from a squared curve at one end through a straight line at the middle to a square-root curve at the other

inputs.text: A voltage of 1V or more opens the first envelope, and dropping below it starts the release
A voltage of 1V or more opens the second envelope, and dropping below it starts the release
Scales the first envelope's attack, decay and release times together, in 256 steps; the jack reads as half the knob settings while nothing is patched
Scales the second envelope's attack, decay and release times together, in 256 steps; the jack reads as half the knob settings while nothing is patched

notes: the attack, decay and release times a knob shows are the times before the control CV jack scales them; with that jack empty the real times are half of what the tooltip reads
the panel is lettered in Japanese with the English subtitles ENVELOPE GENERATOR I and ENVELOPE GENERATOR II over the two halves

inputs.0:
unipolar · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
unipolar · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:

unpatched it reads 0V, which halves the three times; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.

unpatched it reads 0V, which halves the three times; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
